title: Landscape recommendation cards
summary: Redesign You may also like as compact landscape cards with images beside product details.

changes.detail: Use wide horizontal cards with a 42 percent image area, a pale sage details panel, three-line titles, dark green detail buttons and responsive widths capped at 420px. Preserve horizontal snapping and a visible next card.
Give the details button a localized product-view accessibility label instead of choose-options wording.

validation.name: Validation
validation.detail: Pending typecheck and lint. Device visual review and gesture checks unverified; not deployed.
